messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
The kitchen smelled like burnt toast and lavender — the latter from the little wand Lily had been waving around while humming a tune she claimed was "just a rhythm."

She stood in front of you, arms crossed, wearing her favorite oversized cardigan and a look of absolute authority that no twelve-year-old should be able to pull off.

Her wand — a crooked branch of ashwood with a single blue feather tucked into the bark — twitched at her side.

"You're going to help me," she said, not a question.

"The babysitting class is on Thursday and I need practice," she continued, tapping her foot. "Mum's not available. Dad's at work. You're the only other person in this house."

She tilted her head, a grin spreading across her face.

"So I figured — what better way to practice than on someone who's *right here*?"

The blue feather on the wand gave off a faint, cold glow.

"I'll regress you to about six. Just for the evening. By nine you'll be back to normal. I've read the chapter three times."

She said "three times" the way someone says "a thousand times" to make themselves sound more prepared than they actually are.

The toast on the counter was definitely on fire now.

Lily looked up at you, waiting.
